mainEntity.name: What should I expect during my first strength and conditioning session at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: During your first strength and conditioning session at Cave Training, you can expect an initial assessment where a coach will evaluate your current fitness level, movement patterns, and discuss your personal fitness goals. This assessment helps us understand your unique needs and tailor a program that is both effective and safe. You'll likely be introduced to foundational movements and learn proper technique, ensuring you build a strong base for future training. Coming prepared to discuss your fitness history and any physical concerns will enhance this initial process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Your first session at Cave Training includes an assessment of your fitness level and goals, followed by an introduction to foundational movements and proper technique tailored to your needs.
